create_bottleneck_block: create a BottleneckBlock with Conv3d layers, BatchNorm3d, and ReLU for video feature extraction
create_separable_bottleneck_block: create a SeparableBottleneckBlock with sum or cat reduce method for multi-branch convolutions
create_acoustic_bottleneck_block: create an acoustic SeparableBottleneckBlock with configurable norm and activation callables
create_res_block: create a ResBlock with a BottleneckBlock branch and optional skip connection conv
create_resnet: create a full ResNet video model with stem, stages, and head using callable builders
